54.note: six seasons and a movie. NOT born here, abed says it first in the paradigms clip show. this is the second time, and the series finale is the third
54.label: backward and forward, origin corrected
54.check: I assumed this was the origin and the corpus says otherwise. S02E21 L140 is first: "Show's gonna last three weeks! Six seasons and a movie!" Here at L54-55 Troy and Abed say it to each other about Cougar Town. It closes the series at S06E13 L294, "That's six seasons and a movie", with L175 "I mean we've got through six seasons." Three uses in 110 episodes, and the show ends on the third.

111.note: cougarton abbey runs six episodes then the whole cast drinks hemlock. that is sitting fifty lines from 'six seasons and a movie' on purpose

111.check: Both beats are in this episode and they argue with each other. L145-147 "Why did everyone on Cougarton Abbey just die? They only ran six episodes. That's the great thing about British tv. They give you closure." Fifty-seven lines earlier, L54, Troy and Abed comfort each other with "six seasons and a movie." No later episode calls back to Cougarton Abbey, so this is a reading of the placement rather than a tracked seed.

258.check: L258-261 "Helping Abed has inspired me to finally declare a major. I'm gonna study Psychology. Like in a research capacity? No, in a hands-on capacity. I'm gonna be a therapist." The joke is that she is bad at it: S04E02 L249 "The worst therapist? No, because you're not a therapist."
